DIAGNOSIS READY: Acute Pyelonephritis.

The clinical presentation of fever, flank pain, and fatigue following sinusitis, combined with urinalysis showing leukocyturia and negative culture (suggestive of prior antibiotic suppression), confirms an upper urinary tract infection. I am proceeding with this diagnosis based on the symptomatic evidence.
